headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 11, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals fell to the New York Mets in a thrilling finish, 5-4. Jared Young led the Cardinals' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. In other action, the Detroit Tigers dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing an 11-0 victory, while the Miami Marlins secured a shutout victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Ramón Urías has been placed on the 60-day injured list by the St. Louis Cardinals due to right elbow lateral epicondylitis. The Toronto Blue Jays have placed Daulton Varsho on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 10, 2026, with left wrist inflammation. Other players on the injured list include Javier Báez (Detroit Tigers), Will Smith (Los Angeles Dodgers), Jalen Beeks (Texas Rangers), Oneil Cruz (Pittsburgh Pirates), Sebastián Rivero (Los Angeles Angels), and Jack Kochanowicz (Los Angeles Angels).

The Chicago White Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations. The Detroit Tigers have also made a trade, acquiring RHP Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Mets in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets edged out the St. Louis Cardinals 5-4 in a closely contested game. Jared Young led the Cardinals' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Twins 11-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing a convincing 11-0 victory. Keider Montero led the way for the Tigers, pitching 6.1 innings with 4 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Diamondbacks 2-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a shutout victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with Tyler Phillips earning the win after pitching 5.0 innings with 5 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Royals 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a 4-2 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Corey Seager leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. Beck Way made a strong relief appearance, striking out 4 batters in 2 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Place Ramón Urías on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: St. Louis Cardinals third baseman Ramón Urías has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to right elbow lateral epicondylitis.

top_news.title: **White Sox Acquire Nolan Jones in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations.
